allow: PowerShell($active = 'OpenClaw Watchdog','KnowledgeSystemProjectionSync','KnowledgeSystemStandingServices','JarvisScreenshot'; foreach \($name in $active\) { $t = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($t\) { Write-Output "=== $name ==="; Write-Output \("  Hidden:  " + $t.Settings.Hidden\); foreach \($a in $t.Actions\) { Write-Output \("  Exec:    " + $a.Execute\); Write-Output \("  Args:    " + $a.Arguments\); Write-Output \("  WorkDir: " + $a.WorkingDirectory\) }; Write-Output '' } })

PowerShell(Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-TaskScheduler/Operational'; Id=200} -MaxEvents 60 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object TimeCreated, @{n='Task';e={$_.Properties[0].Value}}, @{n='Action';e={$_.Properties[1].Value}} | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap)
PowerShell(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name='cmd.exe' OR Name='powershell.exe' OR Name='conhost.exe' OR Name='pwsh.exe'")

PowerShell($startup = @\('C:\\Users\\iAmiK\\AppData\\Roaming\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup','C:\\ProgramData\\Microsoft\\Windows\\Start Menu\\Programs\\Startup'\); $startup | ForEach-Object { if \(Test-Path $_\) { Write-Output "=== $_ ==="; Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $_ | Select-Object Name, Length, LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize } })

PowerShell($log = 'C:\\Users\\iAmiK\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\cmd-spawn-log.txt'; $lines = Get-Content $log; Write-Output "Total spawn events: $\($lines.Count\)"; Write-Output ''; Write-Output '=== Spawned process names \(counts\) ==='; $lines | ForEach-Object { if \($_ -match 'PID=\\d+ \(\\S+\)'\) { $matches[1] } } | Group-Object | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object Count, Name | Format-Table -AutoSize; Write-Output ''; Write-Output '=== Top parent processes \(counts\) ==='; $lines | ForEach-Object { if \($_ -match 'parent PID=\\d+ \(\\S+\)'\) { $matches[1] } } | Group-Object | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 Count, Name | Format-Table -AutoSize)

PowerShell($tasks = @\('KnowledgeSystemProjectionSync','KnowledgeSystemStandingServices','Hermes WSL Keepalive','JarvisScreenshot'\); foreach \($t in $tasks\) { $task = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($task\) { Write-Output "===== $t ====="; Write-Output "State: $\($task.State\)"; Write-Output "Hidden: $\($task.Settings.Hidden\)"; foreach \($a in $task.Actions\) { Write-Output "Execute: $\($a.Execute\)"; Write-Output "Arguments: $\($a.Arguments\)"; Write-Output "WorkingDir: $\($a.WorkingDirectory\)" }; foreach \($tr in $task.Triggers\) { Write-Output "Trigger: $\($tr.CimClass.CimClassName\) | Repeat: $\($tr.Repetition.Interval\)" }; Write-Output "" } })
